logline: Martin, a young man who has recently moved to Bratislava

family: a Sunday lunch with his girlfriend's family
a phone call with his mother
daily: a café in the old town
a tram ride across the city
work: his first week at a new job
writing an email to the boss
offices: a form that has to be filled in
a phone call to the bank
media: a Slovak film at the cinema
exam: a language course in the evening
a study day before an exam
curious: a Slovak word that puzzles him

cafe.title: Kaviareň
cafe.blurb: Order coffee and cake in Bratislava
cafe.brief: a waiter in a small café in Bratislava's old town; I want to order coffee and something sweet, and ask what's good
cafe.task: Order a coffee and something sweet, and ask what is good.

way.title: Na ulici
way.blurb: Ask a stranger the way to the station
way.brief: a friendly local on Obchodná ulica; I am lost and need to get to the main train station
way.task: You are lost. Find out how to get to the main station.

colleague.title: Nový kolega
colleague.blurb: Meet a new colleague on day one
colleague.brief: my new colleague at the office; we meet at the coffee machine on my first day and get to know each other
colleague.task: It is your first day. Get to know your new colleague.

shop.title: Na trhu
shop.brief: a stallholder at the Miletičova market; I want vegetables and fruit for a soup, and to ask about prices
shop.task: Buy what you need for a soup, and ask about prices.

doctor.title: U lekára
doctor.blurb: Explain to a doctor what hurts
doctor.brief: a GP in a Slovak clinic; I have a sore throat and a headache since yesterday
doctor.task: Tell the doctor what hurts and since when.

family.title: Rodina
family.blurb: Talk about your family with a new friend
family.brief: a new Slovak friend at a party who asks about my family, where they live and what they do
family.task: Tell a new friend about your family.

station.title: Na stanici
station.blurb: Buy a train ticket to Poprad-Tatry
station.brief: a ticket counter clerk at the main train station; I need a return ticket to Poprad-Tatry with a seat reservation
station.task: Buy a return train ticket to Poprad-Tatry and ask which platform the train leaves from.

restaurant.title: V kolibe
restaurant.blurb: Order traditional Slovak dinner at a mountain koliba
restaurant.brief: a waiter in a traditional mountain koliba; I want to try bryndzové halušky and a draft Kofola, and pay by card
restaurant.task: Order traditional sheep cheese dumplings, drink, and pay by card.

hotel.title: V hoteli
hotel.blurb: Check into a guest house in the High Tatras
hotel.brief: a receptionist at a mountain guest house in Starý Smokovec; I have a reservation for two nights, need the wifi and breakfast info
hotel.task: Check into your room, ask about breakfast times and the wifi password.

cast.name: Martin
cast.role: the lead: a young man who has just moved to Bratislava and takes the city one word at a time

cast.name: Zuzka
cast.role: Martin's neighbor in Petržalka; she shows him the city and keeps his Slovak honest

cast.name: Eva
cast.role: the barista at the café in the old town; she remembers everyone's order and everyone's business

cast.name: Tomáš
cast.role: Martin's colleague at the office; he explains the country over coffee and football

cast.name: Pán Ján
cast.role: the stallholder at the Miletičova market; grumpy until he is greeted properly

cast.name: Mária
cast.role: a doctor at the clinic; patient with learners, strict about rest

places.note: the shopping street where a stranger is asked the way — the Speak way scene

places.name: the office in the new building
places.note: where Martin works and meets Tomáš — the Speak colleague scene

places.name: the Miletičova market
places.note: the market where the shopping goes on — the Speak shop scene

places.name: Mária's clinic

places.name: Zuzka's family flat in Petržalka

beats.hello: Martin arrives in Bratislava with two suitcases and meets Zuzka in the stairwell.
beats.cafe: Martin orders his first coffee alone; Eva saves him when the words run out.
beats.town: Martin gets lost looking for the main station and asks his way along Obchodná.
beats.family: Zuzka takes Martin to her family's Sunday lunch, where her mother asks more than his Slovak answers.
beats.everyday: Martin settles into a routine: up early, the tram to work, the shopping on the way home.
beats.yesterday: Martin tells Zuzka how his first week went, and what went wrong in it.
beats.health: Martin wakes with a sore throat and visits Mária, who orders rest in writing.
beats.shopping: Zuzka sends Martin to the Miletičova market for soup vegetables, where pán Ján quizzes him on the price.
beats.plans: Martin and Zuzka plan a weekend trip and argue with the weather forecast.
beats.moving: Martin rides the train to Košice for a match, muddles the platform change, still makes kick-off.
beats.people: Tomáš brings his brother to dinner and Martin has to describe everyone without mixing them up.
beats.work: Martin survives his first Slovak phone call at work and a meeting he understood half of.
beats.stories: Martin recounts the Košice trip at a team lunch, fixing the order of events while Zuzka winces.
beats.opinions: The office argues about a new tram line, and Martin gives his first real opinion in Slovak.
beats.offices: Martin sorts out a wrong delivery and a form at the foreigners' police office.
beats.world: A news item about a flooded Danube path gives Martin something to read and something to say at lunch.
beats.nuance: Martin writes to his landlord about a broken boiler and debates how much to soften the letter.
beats.register: At Zuzka's family table Martin hears the street version of every phrase he learned, and keeps them apart.
beats.media: Martin watches the evening news with Zuzka's family and follows it without the subtitles.
